panels.description: Estados observados por el logger; interpolación escalonada, válida hasta la siguiente lectura o un máximo de 60 s. El timestamp fuente no se usa para medir transmisión. La captura reciente fue de 20–29 s.

targets.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (
 SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS lo, $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS hi
), mapping(asset,rx,fls,plc) AS (VALUES
('RM1','ns=2;s=OPT_RX.Optibat.Heartbeats.OPT_W_RM1_COMM_FLAG','OPT_W_RM1_COMM_FLAG','PAC2.RM1.Heartbeats.OPT_W_RM1_COMM_FLAG'),
('RM2','ns=2;s=OPT_RX.Optibat.Heartbeats.RM2_HbOpW','RM2_HbOpW','PAC22.RM2.Heartbeats.RM2_HbOpW'),
('K1','ns=2;s=OPT_RX.Optibat.Heartbeats.K1_HbOpW','K1_HbOpW','PAC2.K1.Heartbeats.K1_HbOpW'),
('K2','ns=2;s=OPT_RX.Optibat.Heartbeats.K2_HbOpW','K2_HbOpW','PAC23A.K2.Heartbeats.K2_HbOpW'),
('FM1','ns=2;s=OPT_RX.Optibat.Heartbeats.OPT_W_FM1_COMM_FLAG','OPT_W_FM1_COMM_FLAG','PAC4.FM1.Heartbeats.OPT_W_FM1_COMM_FLAG'),
('FM2','ns=2;s=OPT_RX.Optibat.Heartbeats.FM2_HbOpW','FM2_HbOpW','PAC4.FM2.Heartbeats.FM2_HbOpW'),
('FM3','ns=2;s=OPT_RX.Optibat.Heartbeats.FM3_HbOpW','FM3_HbOpW','PAC24.FM3.Heartbeats.FM3_HbOpW')), nodes AS (
 SELECT n.* FROM mapping m CROSS JOIN LATERAL
 (VALUES ('RX',rx),('FLS/ECS',fls),('PLC',plc)) n(node,tag)
 WHERE asset=${asset:sqlstring}
), raw AS (
 SELECT n.node,t.logger_timestamp AS ts,
 CASE WHEN t.status_code NOT LIKE 'Good%' OR t.status_code IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN lower(trim(t.value))='true' THEN 1
      WHEN lower(trim(t.value))='false' THEN 0
      WHEN trim(t.value) ~ '^[+]?0([.]0+)?$' THEN 0
      WHEN trim(t.value) ~ '^[+]?1([.]0+)?$' THEN 1
      ELSE NULL END AS val
 FROM tags t JOIN nodes n ON t.tag=n.tag CROSS JOIN bounds b
 WHERE t.logger_timestamp >= b.lo-interval '60 seconds' AND t.logger_timestamp <= b.hi
), samples AS (
 SELECT node,ts,CASE WHEN count(val)=count(*) AND count(DISTINCT val)=1
 THEN min(val) END AS val FROM raw GROUP BY node,ts
), ordered AS (
 SELECT *, lead(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY node ORDER BY ts) AS next_ts FROM samples
), intervals AS (
 SELECT node,val,greatest(ts,b.lo) AS a,
 least(coalesce(next_ts,b.hi),ts+interval '60 seconds',b.hi) AS z
 FROM ordered CROSS JOIN bounds b
 WHERE ts < b.hi
)
SELECT time,value AS "RX" FROM (
 SELECT a AS time,node AS metric,val::double precision AS value FROM intervals WHERE z>a
 UNION ALL
 SELECT CASE WHEN z=b.hi THEN z ELSE z-interval '1 microsecond' END,node,val::double precision
 FROM intervals i CROSS JOIN bounds b
 WHERE z>a AND (z=b.hi OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM samples s WHERE s.node=i.node AND s.ts=i.z))
 UNION ALL
 SELECT z,node,NULL::double precision FROM intervals i CROSS JOIN bounds b
 WHERE z>a AND z<b.hi AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM samples s WHERE s.node=i.node AND s.ts=i.z)
) series WHERE metric='RX' ORDER BY time;

panels.title: Heartbeats · ${asset}

panels.description: Un episodio une intervalos consecutivos con ambos bits válidos y distintos. Se corta ante igualdad, mala calidad, falta de lectura durante 60 s o límite del periodo. Los episodios parciales muestran solo la duración observada; consulta la tabla de detalle.

 (VALUES ('RX',rx),('FLS/ECS',fls),('PLC',plc)) n(node,tag)
 WHERE asset=${asset:sqlstring}

 SELECT n.node,t.logger_timestamp AS ts,
 CASE WHEN t.status_code NOT LIKE 'Good%' OR t.status_code IS NULL THEN NULL

      WHEN lower(trim(t.value))='false' THEN 0
      WHEN trim(t.value) ~ '^[+]?0([.]0+)?$' THEN 0
      WHEN trim(t.value) ~ '^[+]?1([.]0+)?$' THEN 1
      ELSE NULL END AS val
 FROM tags t JOIN nodes n ON t.tag=n.tag CROSS JOIN bounds b
 WHERE t.logger_timestamp >= b.lo-interval '60 seconds' AND t.logger_timestamp <= b.hi

 SELECT node,ts,CASE WHEN count(val)=count(*) AND count(DISTINCT val)=1
 THEN min(val) END AS val FROM raw GROUP BY node,ts

 FROM ordered CROSS JOIN bounds b
 WHERE ts < b.hi

, routes(route,src,dst) AS (VALUES
 ('RX → FLS/ECS','RX','FLS/ECS'),('FLS/ECS → PLC','FLS/ECS','PLC')
), spans AS (
 SELECT r.route,greatest(s.a,d.a) AS a,least(s.z,d.z) AS z,s.val<>d.val AS mismatch
 FROM routes r JOIN intervals s ON s.node=r.src JOIN intervals d ON d.node=r.dst
 AND s.a<d.z AND d.a<s.z
 WHERE s.z>s.a AND d.z>d.a AND s.val IS NOT NULL AND d.val IS NOT NULL

('FM1','ns=2;s=OPT_RX.Optibat.Heartbeats.OPT_W_FM1_COMM_FLAG','OPT_W_FM1_COMM_FLAG','PAC4.FM1.Heartbeats.OPT_W_FM1_COMM_FLAG'),
('FM2','ns=2;s=OPT_RX.Optibat.Heartbeats.FM2_HbOpW','FM2_HbOpW','PAC4.FM2.Heartbeats.FM2_HbOpW'),
('FM3','ns=2;s=OPT_RX.Optibat.Heartbeats.FM3_HbOpW','FM3_HbOpW','PAC24.FM3.Heartbeats.FM3_HbOpW')), nodes AS (
 SELECT n.* FROM mapping m CROSS JOIN LATERAL
 (VALUES ('RX',rx),('FLS/ECS',fls),('PLC',plc)) n(node,tag)
 WHERE asset=${asset:sqlstring}
), raw AS (
 SELECT n.node,t.logger_timestamp AS ts,
 CASE WHEN t.status_code NOT LIKE 'Good%' OR t.status_code IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN lower(trim(t.value))='true' THEN 1
      WHEN lower(trim(t.value))='false' THEN 0
      WHEN trim(t.value) ~ '^[+]?0([.]0+)?$' THEN 0
      WHEN trim(t.value) ~ '^[+]?1([.]0+)?$' THEN 1
      ELSE NULL END AS val
 FROM tags t JOIN nodes n ON t.tag=n.tag CROSS JOIN bounds b
 WHERE t.logger_timestamp >= b.lo-interval '60 seconds' AND t.logger_timestamp <= b.hi
), samples AS (
 SELECT node,ts,CASE WHEN count(val)=count(*) AND count(DISTINCT val)=1
 THEN min(val) END AS val FROM raw GROUP BY node,ts
), ordered AS (
 SELECT *, lead(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY node ORDER BY ts) AS next_ts FROM samples
), intervals AS (
 SELECT node,val,greatest(ts,b.lo) AS a,
 least(coalesce(next_ts,b.hi),ts+interval '60 seconds',b.hi) AS z
 FROM ordered CROSS JOIN bounds b
 WHERE ts < b.hi
)

 SELECT n.node AS "Nodo",n.tag AS "Tag",t.value AS "Valor",t.status_code AS "Calidad",
 t.logger_timestamp AS "Lectura del logger",t.source_timestamp AS "Timestamp fuente",
 round(extract(epoch FROM b.hi-t.logger_timestamp)::numeric,1) AS "Edad al fin del periodo (s)"
 FROM nodes n CROSS JOIN bounds b LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
 SELECT value,status_code,logger_timestamp,source_timestamp FROM tags
 WHERE tag=n.tag AND logger_timestamp BETWEEN b.lo AND b.hi
 ORDER BY logger_timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
 ) t ON true ORDER BY n.node;
